text:
Nina: Heads-up 500: opened PR to add short migration notes and language parity for Optimize toolkit (batching, kv prefetch, quant profiles). Small edits but need someone to sanity-check snippets + links before merge.

Egor: Which snippets are included?

Nina: Rust, Java, and a short curl example for quick smoke tests. Also moved an internal console link to the public console path.

Priya: I can check the curl and Java snippets. Which SDK version are we targeting?

Nina: Docs target is 0.10.x but examples should remain backward-compatible with 0.9.x where possible; Java example uses package ai.redwood.optimize and a minimal Batch call.

Mark: I'll take the Rust snippet. I noticed the quant-profile example references a `low-memory` tag that isn't documented elsewhere. Can we add a one-line explanation?

Nina: Good catch. Added a sentence: "low-memory: profile tuned for constrained GPU memory using 4-bit quantization; expect small additional latency but large memory savings."

Egor: Quick review: the curl example uses header "X-API-KEY" but our console prefers Authorization: Bearer. We should standardize.

Nina: Updated curl to Authorization: Bearer in commit 2.

Priya: Java snippet compiles against 0.10.0 after I adjusted imports. Also added a comment about client reuse across threads. Pushed commit 3.

Mark: Rust compile: needed tokio note and removed an extra semicolon in the builder chain. cargo check passes locally. Pushed commit 4.

DocsBot: l10n-checker: docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md  missing i18n frontmatter.

Nina: Added frontmatter and the minimal metadata field in commit 5.

Egor: I also fixed a broken anchor to /console/optimize/kv-prefetch (was /guides/kv). Pushed commit 6.

Priya: Ran the Java example against the smallseq bench corpus, same microbench command included in the PR. Observed ~3% p95 improvement with kv-prefetch and batch=8 on shortseq. Added a brief note in the doc.

Nina: Great. Any last blockers?

Mark: All good from my side. Approving.

Priya: Approving. :white_check_mark:

Egor: Approved and merged. :tada:

Nina: Thanks all! I'll add a blurb to the docs changelog and link to the microbench command for reproducibility.
